nodes.name: Hydrothermal NiFeMn-LTH Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Furtherly, 1.0 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 1.0 mmol MnSO4·H2O, 0.5 mmol Fe(NO3)3·9H2O, 6.0 mmol CO(NH2)2 and 1.0 mmol NH4F were added into 40 mL of deionized water and 10 mL of ethanol. The mixed solution was then magnetically stirred for 15 min to form a homogeneous solution. The obtained solution was later transferred to a 100 mL Teflon-lined stainless autoclave with a piece of cleaned NF. The autoclave was maintained at 120°C for 6 h. As the temperature decreased, the obtained NiFeMn-LTH was taken out and cleaned with deionized water and ethanol. NiFeMn-LTH was ready for phosphorization after being dried at 60°C overnight.

nodes.name: Phosphorization to Mn-doped Ni2P/Fe2P
nodes.procedure: 1.0 g of NaH2PO2 was put on the upstream side, and NiFeMn-LTH was placed in the middle of the quartz tube. After the tube furnace was kept at 300°C for 2 h under Ar atmosphere with a ramping rate of 2°C min⁻¹, the obtained Mn-doped Ni₂P/Fe₂P anchored on NF was taken out when the tube furnace cooled down. The as-fabricated electrocatalyst was then cleaned with deionized water and ethanol several times and subsequently dried in the oven at 60°C overnight.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS survey spectra show high purity with no impurities for all electrocatalysts. Mn 2p₃/₂ peaks at 642.3, 642.1, 641.9 eV indicate Mn²⁺ doping. Ni 2p shows Ni-P (853.2/870.5 eV), Ni²⁺, Ni³⁺ with positive shift for Mn-doped Ni₂P/Fe₂P. Fe 2p shows Fe-P (706.8/719.9 eV), Fe²⁺, Fe³⁺ with negative shift. P 2p shows M-P (129.5/130.3 eV) and oxidation (133.6 eV).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XPS survey spectra of as-synthesized electrocatalysts are displayed in Figs. S8 and S9, in which no signal of impurities is observed... According to the above XPS results, the Mn element is successfully doped into as-fabricated electrocatalysts...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES shows positive shift, Fe K-edge negative shift, Mn K-edge higher than foil (Mn²⁺) for Mn-doped Ni₂P/Fe₂P. FT-EXAFS: Ni K-edge Ni-P (1.8Å), Ni-M (2.3Å); Fe K-edge Fe-O (1.2-1.5Å), Fe-P (1.9Å), Fe-M (2.2-2.5Å); Mn K-edge Mn-O (~1.6Å), Mn-M (2-3Å). WT-EXAFS confirms path contributions and shifts due to Mn doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 4a and b show their Ni and Fe K-edge XANES spectra respectively... Therefore, the above results prove that Mn doping and Ni₂P/Fe₂P heterointerfaces can efficiently modulate the electronic structure...
